attempts_outcome.name: attempts_outcome
attempts_outcome.value: outcome is null or outcome in ('succeeded', 'failed_retryable', 'failed_final', 'uncertain')

inbound_drafts_risk.name: inbound_drafts_risk
inbound_drafts_risk.value:
(risk_level is null) = (risk_score is null) and (risk_level is null) = (risk_probabilities is null)
    and (risk_level is null) = (risk_confidence is null) and risk_score between 0 and 100 and risk_threshold between 0 and 100

inbound_drafts_target.name: inbound_drafts_target
inbound_drafts_target.value: (kind = 'message') = (conversation_id is not null) and (kind = 'comment') = (response_id is not null)

inbound_drafts_digest.name: inbound_drafts_digest
inbound_drafts_digest.value: (draft_text is null) = (draft_digest is null) and (draft_digest is null or draft_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

outgoing_messages_delivery_status.name: outgoing_messages_delivery_status
outgoing_messages_delivery_status.value: delivery_status is null or delivery_status in ('sent', 'delivered', 'read', 'failed')

outgoing_messages_settled_by.name: outgoing_messages_settled_by
outgoing_messages_settled_by.value: settled_by is null or settled_by in ('worker', 'reconcile', 'operator')

outgoing_messages_resolution.name: outgoing_messages_resolution
outgoing_messages_resolution.value: resolution is null or resolution in ('sent', 'not_sent')

outgoing_messages_approved_via.name: outgoing_messages_approved_via
outgoing_messages_approved_via.value: approved_via in ('person', 'automation') and (approved_via = 'automation') = (draft_id is not null)

replies_settled_by.name: replies_settled_by
replies_settled_by.value: settled_by is null or settled_by in ('worker', 'reconcile', 'operator')

replies_resolution.name: replies_resolution
replies_resolution.value: resolution is null or resolution in ('sent', 'not_sent')

replies_approved_via.name: replies_approved_via
replies_approved_via.value: approved_via in ('person', 'automation') and (approved_via = 'automation') = (draft_id is not null)
